scope_note: Published FSSR product quality standards only; no declaration of lot conformity or contaminant article applicability.

cases.identity: Hard-boiled and peeled hen or quail eggs in a vinegar-based or oil-based pickling preparation; actual product variant must be established.

quality_requirements.basis: Vinegar-based egg pickle; composition table on Gazette p.31
Vinegar-based brine, NOT a 3.2–3.6 acceptable range
Oil-based solution; not vinegar-based pH criterion

process_evidence: Identify vinegar versus oil-based finished product and actual hen/quail egg supplier and cooking process.
For vinegar variant: verify salt-water simmer, vinegar-water 50:50, hot filling 70 ± 2 °C, egg-to-solution ratio 1:1.25, and minimum 48-hour maturation as published.
For oil variant: document fried-egg processing, gravy formula and egg-to-gravy mass ratio 70:30 ±1%, acetic-acid addition, minimum 48-hour maturation.
Confirm final-product microbiological Appendix B and finished pickling solution chemical results; a review note is not an actual report.
cases.amendment_precedence_note: 2024 first amendment completely substituted 2.5.3(5) operative 1 May 2025. Do not reuse older blanket pH 3.2–3.6 range or the older 0.6–0.8 acidity band.

cases.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
cases.identity: Cow/buffalo colostrum collected about 3–5 days after parturition; distinguish raw liquid colostrum from colostrum powder made through drying.

quality_requirements.basis: 2024 Gazette substituted column in 2.1.23, item 2(I)(a), Table row 7
2024 Gazette substituted column in 2.1.23 item 2(II)(b), Table row 8; do not use legacy 12.5% immunoglobulins criterion

process_evidence: Document liquid colostrum versus powder as-sold identity, cow/buffalo source and postpartum collection time.
Obtain validated IgG-specific assay and report. The amended analyte is IgG, not a generic total-immunoglobulin result.
Check remaining clause 2.1.23 criteria in operative FSSR chapter, including moisture, protein, fat and other quality parameters, plus microbiological requirements.
cases.amendment_precedence_note: 2024 Gazette amended item 2.1.23 IgG entries to 1.8% liquid and 8.5% powder effective 1 May 2025; older powder 12.5% total-immunoglobulin text must not override.
